notes: Solved independently first with the exponential form of Newton's law of cooling, which is the form the supplied logarithms point to. First case: (40−10)/(100−10) = 1/3, so 10k = ln 3 = 1.1 and k = 0.11 per minute. Second case: (20−10)/(70−10) = 1/6, so kt = ln 6 = 1.8 and t = 1.8/0.11 = 16.36 min, which is option 4. Python cross-check with true logarithms gives 16.31 min, the same option. The alternative average-temperature form of the law gives 14.29 min, which matches no option, confirming the exponential form is the one intended. The single common_mistakes entry describes a constant-rate route giving 50/6 = 8.33 min; its option field is null rather than 2, and since the printed option is 8.5 min the entry does not claim a match it cannot support, so this was checked and not filed. difficulty 'hard' is defensible for a two-case exponential problem and was not filed.
